test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which Indian city is known as the hub for chess training?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chennai**__.

**__Key Points__**

__

• **Chennai** is globally recognized as the **Chess Capital of India** due to its deep-seated culture of the sport and exceptional training infrastructure.

• The city’s chess legacy is pioneered by **Viswanathan Anand**, who became India’s first **Grandmaster** in **1988** and a five-time **World Chess Champion**.

• As of **2023**, **Tamil Nadu** leads the country with the highest density of elite players, producing over **30 Grandmasters** out of India’s total pool, with the majority based in **Chennai**.

• The city successfully hosted the **44th Chess Olympiad** in **2022** at **Mamallapuram**, marking the first time this prestigious global event was held on Indian soil.

• Prominent training centers like the **Chess Gurukul** and the **Bloom Chess Academy** are located here, offering specialized coaching that has nurtured talents like **R Praggnanandhaa** and **Gukesh D**.

 **Additional Information__**

• **Pune**:

• Known as the **Oxford of the East**, it is a significant educational hub and historically associated with the development of **Badminton**.

• **Kolkata**:

• Regarded as the **Cultural Capital of India**, it has a storied history in **Football** and produced India’s second Grandmaster, **Dibyendu Barua**.

• **Delhi**:

• Serves as the administrative center for the **All India Chess Federation (AICF)** and frequently hosts high-stakes **International Open** tournaments.
